name: snapshot
title: Look at the page
description: See the active tab: its accessibility tree with a ref (e5) per element (as: tree, default; only what changed after the first call), its text as markdown (as: markdown; with url, fetched over HTTP without touching any tab), or a screenshot (as: image).

interactive.description: tree: only elements to act on (default true).

selector.description: tree: CSS selector of the subtree to read.

urls.description: tree or markdown: show link targets.

full.description: tree: the whole tree, not a delta.

find.description: tree: only lines containing this text, with their parents; the next delta still compares against the last full view.

viewport.description: tree: only what is on screen, plus a line saying what lies beyond.

outline.description: markdown: headings only, with line numbers.

filter.description: markdown: keep sections mentioning this text.

maxChars.description: markdown: chars per answer, at most the server's limit.

offset.description: markdown: start at this char; a cut answer names the next offset.

url.description: markdown: fetch this page over HTTP instead of reading the tab.

raw.description: markdown with url: the body as served.

requireMd.description: markdown with url: fail unless the site serves markdown.

llms.description: markdown with url: the site's llms.txt or llms-full.txt.

save.description: image: also keep a file and report savedTo.

name: act
title: Act in the browser
description: Run one browser action — {"do":"<action>", ...its input} — or several in order — {"batch":[{"do":...},...], "bail":true}. Action names and inputs come from guide. Element inputs take a ref ("e5") or a locator. A batch answers with one delta, after its last page-changing step.

name: guide
title: Browser actions and playbooks
description: Without a topic: whether a browser is connected, every action you can run with act, by group, and the playbooks. With a topic: one action's description and input, a group's guide, or a playbook.
